author: 744franciscojavierj

title: La Sagrada Familia
text:
If you see one thing in Barcelona it should be the interior of La Sagrada Familia.  It is the creation of Gaudi, a true visionary and genius.  The use of light, forms based on nature and space took my breath away.  The exterior is beautiful too but surrounded by massive crowds.
Hop on hop off bus was a great way to get around town.  Multiple stops at many attractions.
author: E5004LFlisak

title: Do not miss this
text:
Allow yourself time to wander and take it slowly. So much to see and feel. Amazing sight inside and out. Read the displays and information at each viewing.

We had trouble with one of our entry tickets. We were told it had already been used to gain entry an hour previously. Viator resent a ticket but it was the same code already used . We were told by staff unfortunately if happens a lot that codes are sent out lots of times to many people and once used they become invalid. We had to purchase another entry ticket on the day.
